thread:
ana: Quick sync 1: need a minimal phased preheat + admission playbook for Dedicated reserved pools. Customers want burst reliability but we must limit GPU spend.

ben: Suggest defaults: preheat_window=10m, soft_window=20m, soft_ratio=0.25, gpu_preheat=false by default. Keep it conservative for GA.

chloe: UX: onboarding modal should show 'estimated preheat cost' and a toggle to opt into GPU preheat with a clear cap.

raj: Telemetry: emit events gpu_preheat_start/gpu_preheat_cost, stage_entered, admit_latency. Dashboards for preheat_spend by tenant.

ana: Ops needs region caps and a fast feature-flag kill switch. Also a runbook for stuck admits.

ops-bot: infra-bot: Planning canary rollout 2025-08-12 02:00 UTC.

ben: Billing: convert preheat cap to token-equivalent so it shows in usage pages; default $10 for trials, configurable per-customer.

chloe: Launch gates: telemetry in place, preheat leakage <1% in canary, documented rollback.

ana: Action items: ana draft spec, ben PR for controller + flags, raj telemetry schema, ops runbook. Meeting Monday to lock defaults.

ana: thanks all :thumbsup:
